mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (monetary easing) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.7%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary tightening (rising FEDFUNDS) and labor market deterioration (rising UNRATE) signal a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1600), a lower HOUST level (indicating worsening conditions) reduces consumer confidence and housing-related spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher year-over-year CPIAUCSL (inflation) compresses real corporate margins and increases the risk of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment below 137,000 thousand signals weak labor demand, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 137000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high GDPC1 periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
